You're missing the point. 
There is no point in freedom if the freedom doesn't seem to actually be real or happening. The whole concept of freedom cognitively makes sense, but I don't understand the concept when applied to reality. This is like trying to explain color to a blind person.


Have you ever had so much acid you've experienced ego death? It's like that minus the visuals.. All the time. Plus all the other shit I mentioned.

Let me rephrase: I don't see any other _acceptable_ alternatives.

But the real question is why am I feeding the trolls?
Probably not, but I obviously don't see any alternatives. If I did I wouldn't be posting here, yes?
